ShortDescription.Value: Nothing to see here. Yeet your top-left mod buttons out of the way with one click, and bring them back when you need them.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Yeet Bar *Nothing to see here.*
Too many mod buttons in the top-left corner? Click the arrow and they slide away. Click it again and they're back.
- Want the top-right corner tidied too? Switch it on in Options and it gets its own arrow. - Alt + C does the same as the arrows. You can change the key in Options. - Slide speed is up to you: 0.25, 0.5 or 1 second, or no animation at all.
It only moves buttons on screen. Your saves are never touched, and unsubscribing puts everything back.
I made this for myself as a little QoL mod, but any feedback is appreciated. Made with Claude by Anthropic.
